rules.summary: Imported atom labels with no object-level LineHeight or LabelLineHeight must remain inherited on export; an explicit value is emitted only after the effective line-height setting is edited.
rules.officialRule: LabelLineHeight is optional. When absent, ChemDraw inherits the containing object or document value, then the style sheet, and finally treats the label as Variable.

rules.summary: Atom, query-list, and carbon-display labels generated from node properties remain derived on CDX/CDXML export. ChemSema emits a child Text object only after the label text becomes explicit.
rules.officialRule: Element and ElementList are Node properties, while ShowTerminalCarbonLabels and ShowNonTerminalCarbonLabels control whether carbon labels are displayed. A Text object is a separate arbitrary text block, so an unchanged property-derived node display must not be materialized as authored text.

rules.summary: A CDX/CDXML Text object with Visible=no remains an editable object across export and reimport; visibility controls rendering and does not delete the object.
rules.officialRule: CDX object ID zero means no ID was assigned and is permitted for an unreferenced object. The independent Visible property controls whether an object is displayed. Therefore neither an unassigned ID nor Visible=no permits dropping the Text object from the document.

rules.summary: An ObjectTag child Text without its own CDX object ID remains linked to the tag by owner, semantic role, and content. Automatic enhanced-stereo placement preserves the cached direction vector separately from the rendered text box.
rules.officialRule: Object IDs may be unassigned when an object is not referenced. ObjectTag is the owning metadata object, and PositioningType=auto interprets the cached child geometry as positioning input. Attachment is a relation, not the child object's identity, so it must not make the owner's source ID ambiguous.

rules.summary: A graphical ObjectTag belongs to the individual leaf Graphic that contains it, not to an aggregate ChemSema group that happens to list that Graphic ID. An ID value of zero remains unassigned and cannot merge otherwise independent ObjectTags or child Text objects.
rules.officialRule: CDX object IDs identify individual objects, while zero means no ID was assigned. ObjectTag is a child of its owning object. Therefore a bracket pair container may retain both source Graphic IDs for regeneration, but those aggregate IDs are not aliases for the container and ID zero is never a cross-object reference key.

rules.summary: For ChemDraw JS documents, an omitted ObjectTag PositioningType preserves the authored absolute child Text geometry. The import boundary normalizes that producer convention to explicit absolute positioning so a ChemSema round trip cannot reinterpret it as desktop automatic placement.
rules.officialRule: PositioningType controls whether ObjectTag display geometry is absolute or automatically derived. The public ChemDraw JS fixtures consistently omit the field while authoring absolute child positions; once the producer changes on export, that implicit convention must be made explicit.

rules.summary: Native node properties remain the authoritative atom-number and stereochemical semantics, but an explicitly owned ObjectTag child Text is a real cached display object and remains nested in that relation. Only an unlinked generated display is suppressed, and its now-unreferenced generated style is removed with it.
rules.officialRule: ObjectTag owns its display child objects, while AtomNumber and stereochemical properties carry the native node semantics. Preserving the explicit relation is therefore independent from avoiding duplicate derived labels. A style referenced only by a suppressed generated display has no remaining document owner and must not survive as count drift.

rules.summary: Sibling Text elements with the same assigned object ID and compatible object properties represent ordered parts of one text object. Their styled runs are concatenated once, an empty part contributes no content, and conflicting geometry or representation is rejected explicitly.
rules.officialRule: A nonzero CDX object ID must be unique within its containing object, and Text is one arbitrary block of possibly styled text. Therefore repeated compatible CDXML Text elements carrying the same identity cannot become independent scene objects. Public Indigo fixtures use this transport shape for split style runs and redundant empty tail parts; normalization restores the single official object identity before import and interchange capture.
